# Viewport <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Drawing](BlitzBasic-Drawing)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Viewport:Void x:Int32, y:Int32, width:Int32, height:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the left side of the viewport. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the top of the viewport. |
| `width` | In | Int32 | required | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | In | Int32 | required | Height in pixels. |

## Description

Limits all drawing to a part of the buffer. Anything outside it is cut off, and [Cls](Cls) only clears the inside. The part that sticks out of the buffer is cut off as well. Call `Viewport 0, 0, GraphicsWidth(), GraphicsHeight()` to reset it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 60, 60, 60
Rect 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Viewport 60, 60, 200, 120
Color 255, 120, 0
Oval 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```
